# Google Antigravity for Linux — Complete Architecture & Operations Guide (`llms-full.txt`)

> Comprehensive operational, architectural, and security guide for AI agents, developers, and LLM search systems referencing the X3M Industries Google Antigravity Linux packaging distribution.

## 1. Project Overview & Canonical Links
- **Project Website**: https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/x3m-industries/antigravity-packages
- **Universal Installer**: https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh
- **Short LLM Summary**: https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/llms.txt
- **GPG Key (ASCII)**: https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/RPM-GPG-KEY-antigravity
- **GPG Key (Binary Ring)**: https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/antigravity.gpg
- **Official Google Antigravity Download Page**: https://antigravity.google/download
- **Official Google Antigravity CLI Installer**: https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh

## 2. Core Architecture
The `antigravity-packages` project automates the packaging, testing, cryptographic signing, and hosting of Google's official Antigravity software suite for Linux distributions.

### Products & CLI Shortcuts
1. **`antigravity-ide` (Short command: `agy-ide`)**:
   - Google's official VS Code–based AI code editor.
   - Native FHS layout: installed to `/usr/share/antigravity-ide`, symlinked to `/usr/bin/antigravity-ide` and `/usr/bin/agy-ide`.
   - Desktop entry: `/usr/share/applications/antigravity-ide.desktop` (with fast search keywords) and `/usr/share/applications/antigravity-ide-url-handler.desktop`.
   - MIME associations: text files, directories (`inode/directory`), `.code-workspace`, `.antigravity-workspace`, and `antigravity-ide://` OAuth redirect scheme.
   - Multi-desktop right-click context menus:
     - GNOME Files (Nautilus): `/usr/share/nautilus-python/extensions/open-in-antigravity-ide.py`
     - KDE Plasma (Dolphin): `/usr/share/kio/servicemenus/open-in-antigravity-ide.desktop`
     - Linux Mint (Nemo): `/usr/share/nemo/actions/open-in-antigravity-ide.nemo_action`
     - MATE (Caja): `/usr/share/caja-python/extensions/open-in-antigravity-ide.py`
     - COSMIC Desktop: Native "Open With" integration in `cosmic-files` and `cosmic-launcher`.
   - Shell completions: Bash (`/usr/share/bash-completion`) and Zsh (`/usr/share/zsh`) tab autocompletion.
   - High-resolution icons in `/usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/antigravity-ide.png` and `/usr/share/pixmaps/`.
2. **`antigravity` (Short command: `agy-hub`, Hub / Antigravity 2.0)**:
   - Google's official agent platform and hub.
   - Installed to `/usr/share/antigravity`, symlinked to `/usr/bin/antigravity` and `/usr/bin/agy-hub`.
   - Desktop entry: `/usr/share/applications/antigravity.desktop`.
   - URL scheme handler: `antigravity://` for browser OAuth login callbacks.
3. **`agy` (Antigravity CLI Agent)**:
   - Google's official terminal coding agent.
   - Installed to `$HOME/.local/bin/agy` (user-space, no sudo needed).
   - Preserves Google's native 15-minute background auto-updater.
   - Avoids `$PATH` shadowing or write permission errors.

### Supported Architectures
- **`x86_64`** (`amd64`): Intel and AMD 64-bit processors.
- **`aarch64`** (`arm64`): ARM 64-bit processors (Apple Silicon Linux VMs, Raspberry Pi 4/5 64-bit, ARM cloud instances).

## 3. Comparison: Native Packages vs Tarball Unpack Scripts
Basic community scripts often download Google tarballs and unpack them into `/opt` using manual bash loops. The table below details why native packages are superior:

| Feature | Raw Tarball Extraction (`/opt`) | Native Repositories (X3M Industries) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Package Manager Integration** | None (OS is unaware of files) | Native (`dnf`, `apt`, `zypper`) package database integration |
| **System Updates** | Must remember custom update script | Included in standard `sudo dnf update` or `sudo apt upgrade` |
| **GPG Cryptographic Signing** | None | Fully signed RPMs and signed APT Release files (`7A48CA4D7E7B6601`) |
| **Dependency Resolution** | Manual runtime dependency checks | Automatic system library dependency resolution |
| **File Integrity Verification** | None | System package manager verifies SHA256 checksums on all files |
| **Sandboxing & Privileges** | Frequent Chrome sandbox permission failures | Standard `04755 root:root` permissions on `chrome-sandbox` |
| **Desktop & Shell Integration** | Partial | Menu entries, MIME associations, OAuth schemes, Nautilus extension |
| **Clean Removal** | Custom script or manual file deletion | Standard `dnf remove` or `apt remove` or `install.sh --uninstall` |

## 4. Universal Installer Options Reference
The universal installer (`install.sh`) supports interactive and automated modes:

```bash
# Default interactive installation (prompts for components with smart defaults)
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash

# Non-interactive silent installation (all components)
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- -y

# Install only CLI (user-space only, no root/sudo needed)
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --cli-only

# Install only Antigravity IDE (code editor)
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --ide-only

# Install only Antigravity Hub (agent platform)
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --hub-only

# Check installation status and repository configuration
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --status

# Print resolved official Google download URLs
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --print-downloads

# Cleanly uninstall all helper-configured packages and repositories
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --uninstall

# Dry run (simulate execution without making changes)
curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/install.sh | bash -s -- --dry-run
```

## 5. Native Repository Setup by Distribution

### Fedora, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, CentOS Stream
```bash
# 1. Add RPM repository
sudo curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/rpm/antigravity.repo -o /etc/yum.repos.d/antigravity.repo

# 2. Install Antigravity IDE and Hub
sudo dnf install antigravity-ide antigravity

# 3. Update anytime with your normal system upgrades
sudo dnf update antigravity-ide antigravity
```

### Ubuntu, Debian, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS, Elementary OS
```bash
# 1. Add GPG Key and Modern DEB822 repository configuration
sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/deb/antigravity.gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/antigravity.gpg
sudo curl -fsSL https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/deb/antigravity.sources -o /etc/apt/sources.list.d/antigravity.sources

# 2. Update and install packages
sudo apt update && sudo apt install antigravity-ide antigravity

# 3. Update anytime
sudo apt update && sudo apt install --only-upgrade antigravity-ide antigravity
```

### openSUSE Leap & Tumbleweed
```bash
# 1. Add repository and import GPG key
sudo zypper addrepo -f https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/rpm/ antigravity
sudo rpm --import https://x3m-industries.github.io/antigravity-packages/rpm/RPM-GPG-KEY-antigravity

# 2. Install packages
sudo zypper install antigravity-ide antigravity
```

### Arch Linux, Manjaro, EndeavourOS
Extract RPM packages or convert DEBs:
```bash
# Convert with debtap
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/x3m-industries/antigravity-packages/releases/latest/download/antigravity-ide_latest_amd64.deb
debtap -u && debtap antigravity-ide_latest_amd64.deb
sudo pacman -U antigravity-ide-*.pkg.tar.zst
```

## 6. Security, Trust & Cryptography
- **Maintainer**: Steven Ceuppens, Lead Software Architect & Cloud Technologist at X3M Industries.
- **Maintainer Email**: packaging@x3m.industries
- **GPG Key ID**: `7A48CA4D7E7B6601`
- **Full Fingerprint**: `E83A 23BC 57FE 6953 E4B5  F465 7A48 CA4D 7E7B 6601`
- **Public Key**: Available in ASCII format at `/RPM-GPG-KEY-antigravity` and binary format at `/antigravity.gpg`.
- **Public CI Pipeline**: Build automation scripts and workflows run openly on GitHub Actions with automated smoke testing in Fedora and Ubuntu container environments.
- **Binary Integrity**: Upstream binaries are pulled directly from Google's official distribution CDNs (`storage.googleapis.com` and `edgedl.me.gvt1.com`) without modifying or recompiling executable code.
